notes: Hard. One planner (/app/relay.py) must cut an ordered telemetry stream into consecutive transmit batches under five interacting constraints simultaneously: batch totals must be positive multiples of the granule (individual message units are NOT pre-aligned, so cut points must be chosen to make each batch total frame-aligned), while also respecting batch_cap, fanout, per-cycle unit caps and a global flight cap (cycle_max), with every id shipped exactly once in arrival order. reasoning_depth=3: mod-aware segment cut selection (naive fill-to-cap greed produces non-aligned batches, as probed by a dedicated hidden case) plus order-preserving cycle packing under two more thresholds. quantitative_correctness=3: exact unit arithmetic (batch units = sum of members, cycle units = sum of batches), alignment mod check, cap inequalities, and exactly-once id coverage. adversarial_inputs=2 and hidden_case_generalization=2: five hidden snapshots (empty stream, single message, mod-adversarial stream, fanout=1, 79-message stream) re-run the planner unchanged. The verifier accepts any constraint-satisfying plan (no unique optimum), validating structure programmatically.
